children: Arctic Falls Aktiebolag proposes a dividend of SEK 1.75 per share, totaling SEK 15.8M; no prior-period comparison was provided. The board proposes to set the record date, no later than the day before the next AGM.
The proposed cash return is the release's main investor-relevant item; no prior dividend comparison is provided.
SEK 142.2M of available funds proposed to be carried forward
Most of the SEK 158.1M available for appropriation would remain undistributed, limiting the proposed payout to a portion of those funds.

This is a proposed capital distribution disclosed in an AGM notice, rather than a reported change in operating performance. Shareholders must vote on the proposal, and the board must set the record date within the stated deadline.
